issues.legal_issue: The definition of “plant and machinery” in the explanation to Section 17 does not apply to “plant or machinery” in Section 17(5)(d).

Whether an immovable building qualifies as a “plant” under Section 17(5)(d) must be determined on the facts by applying the functionality test, considering the registered person’s business and the building’s role in it.
Clauses (c) and (d) of Section 17(5) of the CGST Act are not unconstitutional.
Section 16(4) of the CGST Act is not unconstitutional.
The provisions of Section 17(5)(c) and (d) do not require reading down.
